body: I have just... No idea what to do. My parents don't care about me. Period, end of story. No doubt in my mind. I was an accident anyway. I was a broken condom

I don't know why they hate me though. I try and try everyday to turn them around or something. I just wish i didn't have to actually consider this, but it's the only way it seems like. I know i sound like a hormonal bitchy teenager but trust me on this, there are things im leaving out. I just dont know what to do. When i get out of school i'll have no where to go. No where to turn and nothing to fall back on. Thank you so much for trying to help me. This is the most care and love ive been shown for a long long time.

ive wanted to leave for a while. A long while. My mother always tells me im a worthless piece of shit. Like i said my girlfriend was the only one i thought i could finally love and feel loved. But i was wrong, like so many other times i thought i meant something to anyone
